name: Field
summary: The anatomy every input shares: a label above (or beside) the control, an optional or required marker, a hint, one message line (error, warning or success) and a soft character or word count, all wired to the control by id. Not a control itself: it wraps one (or, as a group, several).
a11y: The label is a `label` for the control's id (a `legend` for a group), with the id `{control id}-label` for a control that names itself with `aria-labelledby`. Hint, count and message join `aria-describedby` in reading order; an error, or a count past its limit, sets `aria-invalid`. The count is announced politely only near and past the limit. Icons are decorative: the words say it. As a heading, the label sits in an `h1`.

props.name: label
props.description: A short noun phrase naming what goes in, sentence case, no colon: "Email address".

props.name: children
props.description: The control, given the wiring: `{(control) => <input {...control} />}`. For `group`, the controls inside name themselves.

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence that helps answer: the format, where to find it, what happens to it. Never repeats the label.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. Marks the control invalid and replaces any warning or success line.

props.name: warning
props.description: A caution that doesn't stop the person ("This name is already used in another project").

props.name: success
props.description: A confirmation after a check ("Username available"). Only when the check can fail; never for every valid field.

props.name: necessity
props.description: Fields are required by default, so mark only the exceptions: `optional` adds "(optional)"; `required` adds "(required)" for the rare form that is mostly optional, and sets `aria-required`.

props.name: count
props.description: A soft limit (default): says how many are left, keeps every character typed past it, and shows the excess as an error. `limit: 'hard'` is for a control that stops typing at `max` itself (a `maxLength`): it reads "12 of 60" and turns to a warning at the limit.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` (default): label above. `horizontal`: label beside the control, for dense settings and property panels.

props.name: heading
props.description: The label is the page's heading, for a page that asks one question (`h1`).

props.name: group
props.description: Several controls answer one question (radios, checkboxes, a date in three boxes): a `fieldset` named by a `legend`.

props.name: action
props.description: One action at the end of the label row, such as "Forgot password?" as a Link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The label and messages dim and the control is unavailable. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the hint.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Passed to the control: shown, focusable, not changeable.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label where the row already says what the field is (an inspector); it still names the control.

props.name: after
props.description: A line the control owns, after the messages: a failed save with Retry, kept in the field's rhythm. Give it an id and add that id to the control's `aria-describedby`.
